{"code": "from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('jitc-14-5-g005.jpg').convert('RGB'))
# E plot approximate region x 300:455, y 470:650 based displayed 735x925
reg=im[450:660,280:470]
# black pixels threshold
mask=(reg[:,:,0]<60)&(reg[:,:,1]<60)&(reg[:,:,2]<60)
# list components rough via coordinates
ys,xs=np.where(mask)
print(im.shape, reg.shape, len(xs), xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max())
# cluster points by y,x using simple connected comps scipy? use cv2 unavailable maybe sklearn no. custom dilation
from collections import deque
seen=np.zeros(mask.shape,bool); comps=[]
for y,x in zip(ys,xs):
 if seen[y,x]: continue
 q=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=1; pts=[]
 while q:
  a,b=q.pop(); pts.append((a,b))
  for da in (-1,0,1):
   for db in (-1,0,1):
    aa,bb=a+da,b+db
    if 0<=aa<mask.shape[0] and 0<=bb<mask.shape[1] and mask[aa,bb] and not seen[aa,bb]:
     seen[aa,bb]=1;q.append((aa,bb))
 if len(pts)>10: comps.append(pts)
print(len(comps))
for pts in sorted(comps,key=lambda p:(np.mean([q[0] for q in p]),np.mean([q[1] for q in p]))):
